# Release branches that get the scheduled checks (chaos, govulncheck, flake hunt).
#
# GitHub cron only fires on the default branch, so
# .github/workflows/scheduled-release-branches.yml reads this file and
# dispatches those workflows against each branch listed here. This is the ONE
# place to edit when a release line opens or closes: one branch per line,
# blank lines and # comments ignored. Every branch listed must exist, or the
# dispatcher fails (a retired branch left here should be loud, not silent).
#
# The branch's own copy of each workflow is what runs, so the release branch
# is tested by the CI definition it ships with.
release/v0.20.x
